promise: Let the Cheema lands (Lots 509 and 510) housing proposal be reviewed and negotiated.
quote: I support allowing a development proposal for Lots 509/ 510 for evaluation and negotiation.
their_part: Kept if he votes to let a Cheema lands proposal go forward for review, starting with the growth boundary step. Not kept if he votes to stop it being reviewed.
did_it_happen: Whether council lets a Cheema lands proposal be reviewed.

promise: Keep judging parking shortfalls for new buildings case by case, rather than banning them.
quote: Parking variances for new developments will need to be considered on a case-by-case basis
their_part: Not kept if he votes for a blanket ban on parking variances. Kept if he votes against a blanket ban. His votes on single requests do not count either way.
did_it_happen: Whether council keeps deciding parking variance requests one at a time.

promise: Vote to spend developer parking payments on parking, not on bike and walking projects.
quote: The fees-in-lieu of parking stalls not provided should be considered for allocation to parking facilities in every case – and not necessarily directed to Active Transportation facilities.
their_part: Kept if he votes to put cash in lieu of parking into the parking fund rather than the walking and biking fund. Not kept if he votes the other way.
did_it_happen: Where council decides developer parking payments go.

promise: Protect the few possible parkade sites, including north of Pemberton Avenue.
quote: The scarce potential locations for parkade facilities should be protected – including on the north side of Pemberton Avenue.
their_part: Kept if he votes against selling or rezoning a possible parkade site, such as land north of Pemberton Avenue, for other uses. Not kept if he votes for it.
did_it_happen: Whether possible parkade sites stay available.

promise: Help bring back a downtown RCMP office.
quote: The District should help to facilitate the (re-)establishment of a Downtown RCMP office.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for steps toward a downtown RCMP office, such as funding it or asking the RCMP for it. Not kept if he votes against them.
did_it_happen: Whether a downtown RCMP office opens.

promise: Push to restart Crime Stoppers and Block Watch programs in Squamish.
quote: In addition, the District should examine the need for and facilitate the (re-)establishment of a Squamish CrimeStoppers organization and program, as well as Block Watch and similar neighbourhood-level programs.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for District help to restart Crime Stoppers or Block Watch. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether Crime Stoppers or Block Watch restart in Squamish this term.

promise: Push for a full update of the Parks and Recreation Master Plan alongside the Brennan Park work.
quote: The Brennan Park facilities planning task force currently at work and should be complimented by a comprehensive Parks & Recreation Master Plan update
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to order and fund an updated Parks and Recreation Master Plan. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council orders and funds the updated plan.

promise: Seek a negotiated settlement with Woodfibre LNG that ends the court fights.
quote: I would go after a negotiated settlement and a real reset: a fair, predictable tax arrangement, a workable approach to worker accommodation, and community amenity contributions back on the table
their_part: Kept if she votes for a negotiated agreement with Woodfibre LNG covering taxes and amenities when one comes to council. Not kept if she votes against one.
did_it_happen: Whether the District and Woodfibre LNG reach a new agreement.

promise: Start considering the Cheema lands and Fast properties for housing on higher ground.
quote: We should start considering Fast Properties and Cheema Lands to avoid overbuilding on the floodplain.
their_part: Kept if she votes to let proposals for the Cheema lands or Fast properties be reviewed. Not kept if she votes to stop them being reviewed.
did_it_happen: Whether council reviews proposals for those lands.

promise: Keep the six homes with no parking zoning switched off until frequent buses actually run.
quote: Keep the six-homes-no-parking zoning dormant until frequent buses are actually running.
their_part: Kept if she votes against turning on the six homes, no parking zoning before frequent buses run. Not kept if she votes for it.
did_it_happen: Whether that zoning stays switched off. Provincial housing law sets some of these rules.

promise: Bring a permit for local people living in vehicles to a decision, with a date.
quote: I would bring it back with an actual decision and a date attached.
their_part: Kept if she moves or seconds a motion to bring a residents only vehicle permit to council for a vote with a start date. Not kept if she votes against bringing it forward.
did_it_happen: Whether council votes on such a permit.

promise: Start a land bank now for worker housing and housing society projects.
quote: I also am for creating a land bank starting now for future employee housing, and housing society projects.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes for a land bank, or for buying or reserving land, for worker and non profit housing. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council sets up a land bank or reserves land.

promise: Vote against any more parking variances, and rewrite the parking bylaw for Squamish.
quote: No more parking variances.  Review the bylaw and amend it to Squamish's needs.
their_part: Kept if she votes against each request to cut required parking. Not kept if she votes for one. We show the count, for example 4 of 5.
did_it_happen: How many parking variances council approves.

promise: Move restaurant patios off street parking and stop food trucks parking on Cleveland and 2nd.
quote: Right away, I would move restaurant seating off the street onto the sidewalk and stop food trucks from parking on Cleveland and 2nd between Victoria and Pemberton.
their_part: Kept if she moves or seconds a motion to take patios off parking stalls and bar food trucks from Cleveland and 2nd, and votes for it. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council makes these changes.

promise: Push council to set up a community parking committee right away.
quote: I will push Council to immediately strike a community Parking Committee made up of three downtown business owners, three homeowners from affected neighbourhoods, two Councillors, and the department head responsible for roads.
their_part: Kept if she moves or seconds a motion early in the term to create a community parking committee, or votes for one. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council sets up the committee.

promise: Direct staff to bring a budget with no property tax increase over last year.
quote: Direct Staff to bring a budget to Council that reflects zero increase over last year.
their_part: Kept if she moves or votes for a budget with no property tax increase, and votes against budgets that raise it. Not kept if she votes for a budget with an increase.
did_it_happen: The property tax increase in each budget council adopts, as the District reports it.

promise: Send any big Brennan Park expansion to a referendum, not an alternate approval process.
quote: And if a big expansion is on the table, it goes to a referendum, not an alternate approval process.
their_part: Kept if she votes for a referendum, and against an alternative approval process, when council borrows for a big recreation expansion. Not kept if she votes the other way.
did_it_happen: How council asks voters before borrowing for Brennan Park.

promise: Get simple permit applications decided in under 8 weeks, with published timelines.
quote: Streamline red tape so straightforward permit applications get a decision in under 8 weeks, with clear, published timelines businesses can count on.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes for published permit timelines or an 8 week target for simple permits. Not kept if she votes against them.
did_it_happen: Whether the District publishes timelines and decides simple permits within 8 weeks.
who_decides: District staff, with targets set by council

promise: Finish a Tourism Master Plan in council's first year.
quote: Deliver a comprehensive Tourism Master Plan in year one of the next Council term to support a sustainable tourism economy under our "Hardwired for Adventure" brand.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes to fund and adopt a Tourism Master Plan in council's first year. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council adopts a Tourism Master Plan by about November 2027.

promise: Get a stronger 10 year money deal and a 40 year agreement with Woodfibre LNG.
quote: I would like to see a more robust 10-year agreement. I would also pursue a thoughtful long-term MOU covering the 40-year operations period
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes to reopen talks for a 10 year tax agreement and a longer agreement with Woodfibre LNG. Not kept if she votes against reopening talks.
did_it_happen: Whether the District and Woodfibre LNG sign new agreements.

promise: Create a District job, held by a Squamish Nation member, to link the District and the Nation on Woodfibre LNG.
quote: Create a new District of Squamish liaison role, held by a Squamish Nation member, to serve as a conduit between the District and the Squamish Nation on Woodfibre LNG matters including regulation, local content and procurement.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes to create and fund this liaison job. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether the District creates and fills the job.

promise: Create and carry out a Squamish poverty reduction and affordability plan.
quote: Develop and implement a Squamish Poverty Reduction and Affordability Strategy.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes to adopt and fund a Poverty Reduction and Affordability Strategy. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council adopts and funds one.

promise: Vote no on letting new buildings have less parking than the rules require.
quote: I would vote no to parking variances.
their_part: Kept if she votes against each request to cut required parking. Not kept if she votes for one. We show the count, for example 4 of 5.
did_it_happen: How many parking variances council approves.

promise: Work to start building a second ice rink at Brennan Park in 2027.
quote: On Council, I would work toward shovels in the ground in 2027 for a second rink.
their_part: Kept if she votes for the funding and approvals for a second ice rink at Brennan Park. Not kept if she votes against them.
did_it_happen: Whether construction on a second rink starts in 2027.

promise: Hold property taxes flat in 2027 and 2028, and win council votes to do it.
quote: Deliver a property tax freeze for 2027 and 2028, and build the council support needed to get it done.
their_part: Kept if she moves or votes for 0% budgets in 2027 and 2028, and votes against budgets that raise the District's property tax. Not kept if she votes for a budget with an increase.
did_it_happen: The property tax increase in the 2027 and 2028 budgets council adopts, as the District reports it.

promise: Publish an easy online dashboard of big project budgets and timelines.
quote: Publish a public, plain-language dashboard tracking capital project budgets and timelines, keeping residents informed and Council accountable.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes for a public dashboard of capital project budgets and timelines. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether the District publishes one.

promise: Hold a yearly budget town hall, in person and online, before budget decisions.
quote: Host an annual Budget Town Hall, both in person and online, where the Mayor and Council present and explain the District's budget, increase transparency, answer residents' questions, and provide an opportunity for meaningful public input before budget decisions are made.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes to hold a yearly budget town hall, in person and online, before budget decisions. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council holds one each year.

promise: Vote against rezoning business or industrial land for housing.
quote: Because of that, and despite the difficult choices involved, I would not support rezoning commercial or industrial lands for residential use.
their_part: Counts only rezonings where the staff report says land now zoned for business or industry would allow homes. Kept if he votes against one. Not kept if he votes for one.
did_it_happen: How much business and industrial land council rezones for housing.

promise: Push for regular testing and updating of Squamish's emergency plans.
quote: I will advocate for continual improvements of our emergency plans, regular testing and public communication, stronger coordination with regional and provincial partners, and investments that improve community safety and resilience.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for regular testing and public reports on the District's wildfire and flood plans. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether the District tests, updates and reports on its plans.
who_decides: District staff, with direction from council

promise: Push for developers to pay bigger community amenity contributions.
quote: I will advocate for responsible development, stronger Community Amenity Contributions, better infrastructure coordination, and public spaces and services that support residents of all ages
their_part: Kept if he votes to raise the community amenity contributions the District asks of developers. Not kept if he votes against raising them.
did_it_happen: Whether council raises them.

promise: Push for a District run campground for people living in vehicles and for visitors.
quote: A better solution is to create a municipally operated campground that can serve both vehicle residents and visitors.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for the District to plan and open a campground with basic services for vehicle residents and visitors. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether a District campground opens.

promise: Vote against letting new buildings have less parking than the rules require.
quote: I do not support parking variances that reduce the minimum parking requirements for new developments.
their_part: Kept if he votes against each request to cut required parking. Not kept if he votes for one. We show the count, for example 4 of 5.
did_it_happen: How many parking variances council approves.

promise: Make new developments provide public parking, held for public use forever.
quote: We need to leverage development to secure dedicated public parking, whether through municipal parkades or public stalls integrated within private developments, guaranteed in perpetuity via title covenants.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for a rule or deal that makes a development provide public parking held by a covenant. Not kept if he votes against one.
did_it_happen: Whether council approves projects with public parking held for public use.

promise: Keep short stay shopping parking downtown free, with time limits enforced.
quote: At the same time, commercial short-term parking should remain free to support downtown businesses, backed by consistent time-limit enforcement to ensure steady turnover for shoppers.
their_part: Not kept if he votes to bring in paid parking for short stay shopping spots downtown. Kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether short stay downtown parking stays free.

promise: Push for a stronger community policing presence in Squamish.
quote: If elected, I would advocate for a stronger community policing presence in Squamish.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for more RCMP community policing, such as officers on foot or a local office. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether more community policing happens.

promise: Hold off on a big Brennan Park expansion until there is a clear plan to pay for it.
quote: My approach would be to maintain essential services, improve efficiency, phase upgrades responsibly, and avoid committing to major expansions until we have a clear funding strategy.
their_part: Not kept if he votes to commit to a major Brennan Park expansion before council has adopted a funding plan for it. Kept if he votes against committing first.
did_it_happen: Whether council adopts a funding plan before committing.

promise: Push for a full review of the 10 year budget plan to find savings.
quote: If elected, I would push for a full review of the 10-year plan to identify savings, delay non-essential spending, improve efficiency, and make sure service increases are clearly tied to real community benefit.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for a full review of the 10 year financial plan that lists savings and delayed spending. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council orders the review.

promise: Keep voting to carry out the town's Community Climate Action Plan.
quote: I support the 6 big moves of the town’s existing Community Climate Action Plan and would continue to vote in support of its implementation.
their_part: Kept if she votes for budget items and bylaws that the staff report says carry out the Community Climate Action Plan. Not kept if she votes against them.
did_it_happen: How much of the plan gets done.

promise: Vote against widening the growth boundary without a plan to pay for services and land for affordable housing.
quote: My current view for an OCP discussion is I would only support further expansion of the growth boundary if there is clear, feasible plan for financing and maintaining infrastructure and strong requirements for good planning and design and community benefits such as land for affordable housing.
their_part: Counts only votes to widen the growth boundary. Kept if she votes against one that comes without a plan to pay for services and land for affordable housing. Not kept if she votes for it.
did_it_happen: Whether council widens the boundary, and on what terms.

promise: Support the Hearth and Home program and the Government Road supportive housing.
quote: I support Squamish’s participation in the Province’s Heart and Hearth program and the supportive housing development on Government Road.
their_part: Kept if she votes for the HEART and HEARTH project and the Government Road supportive housing when they come to council. Not kept if she votes against them.
did_it_happen: Whether both projects go ahead.

promise: Support a pilot program for people living in vehicles.
quote: I would support exploring pilot programs that allow us to test what works, learn from the results, and determine whether a broader program is feasible.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes to look at or start a pilot permit or parking program for people who live in vehicles. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether a pilot starts.

promise: Grow the District's housing fund and get land or homes from developers for non-profit housing.
quote: This includes negotiating with developers to provide land or units, building up our housing reserve fund, and supporting zoning relaxations and tax and fee waivers.
their_part: Kept if she votes to add money to the housing reserve fund, for fee waivers for non profit housing, and for deals where developers give land or homes. Not kept if she votes against them.
did_it_happen: How much the housing fund grows.

promise: Update the parking rules for new downtown buildings to match how many cars people really have.
quote: I think it’s time to re-evaluate parking requirements for new Downtown development to make sure they reflect actual vehicle demand.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes to review and update the downtown parking requirements in the zoning bylaw. Not kept if she votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council updates them this term.

promise: Look at resident parking permits, time limits and paid parking downtown.
quote: We should also look at approaches that have worked in other communities, including resident permits, time limits and paid parking.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes to study or bring in resident permits, time limits or paid parking downtown. Not kept if she votes against studying them.
did_it_happen: Whether council studies or brings them in.

promise: Not put a downtown parkade ahead of more pressing building needs.
quote: I’ve heard interest in a Downtown parking structure, but I would not prioritize that over more pressing capital needs.
their_part: Counts only votes to fund a downtown parkade. Not kept if she votes for one while the staff report lists higher priority projects still without money. Kept if she votes against it then.
did_it_happen: Whether council funds a downtown parkade, and when.

promise: Speed up the Brennan Park task force so a replacement is designed and priced.
quote: Then, we need to expedite the work of the existing Brennan Park Task Force to design and begin costing out a replacement project.
their_part: Kept if she moves, seconds or votes for steps that get a Brennan Park replacement designed and priced sooner, such as funding the design. Not kept if she votes against them.
did_it_happen: Whether council gets a design and cost estimate this term.

promise: Work to grow the network of safe bike routes for kids, families and seniors.
quote: I strongly support continued advocacy to build up our transit network, and work to expand Squamish’s safe cycling network for kids, families and seniors.
their_part: Kept if she votes to fund new protected bike routes. Not kept if she votes against them.
did_it_happen: How many new protected bike routes get built.

promise: Put air and water monitoring stations around town to track Woodfibre LNG pollution.
quote: Install extensive air and water monitoring stations throughout the community to track potential impacts in real time
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to fund or secure community air and water monitoring stations that report to the public. Not kept if he votes against them.
did_it_happen: Whether monitoring stations are set up and report results.

promise: Pause approval of new developments unless they clearly make life better and more affordable.
quote: Pausing approval of new development unless it meaningfully improves quality of life and affordability
their_part: Counts only rezonings, which council votes on. Kept if he votes against a rezoning whose staff report shows no affordable homes and no community benefits beyond what the rules require. Not kept if he votes for one.
did_it_happen: How many rezonings council approves.
note: Since Bill 44 (2023), council cannot pause housing that fits existing zoning: those projects need only staff permits. So this can only be tested on rezonings.

promise: Speed up the Pioneer Way supportive housing project.
quote: Expedite the Pioneer Way supportive housing project to create more permanent deeply affordable housing for those facing homelessness
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for steps that move the Pioneer Way supportive housing forward, such as approvals, land or permits. Not kept if he votes against them.
did_it_happen: Whether it gets built, and when.

promise: Raise the share of affordable homes developers must hand over to the District.
quote: Increase the proportion of affordable units that developers must provide to the DOS.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for a policy or bylaw that requires a bigger share of affordable homes in new developments. Not kept if he votes against one.
did_it_happen: Whether council adopts one.

promise: Set up formal shared decision making with the Squamish Nation on land use.
quote: As Mayor, I want to go beyond consultation to genuine, formalized shared decision-making on land use and environmental stewardship
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to start talks or sign an agreement with the Squamish Nation on shared decisions about land use or the environment. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether both governments sign an agreement.

promise: Pick a location for a downtown parkade.
quote: Identifying a location for a parkade.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to choose or reserve a site for a downtown parkade. Not kept if he votes against choosing one.
did_it_happen: Whether council picks a site this term.

promise: Stop letting new buildings get approved with less parking than the rules require.
quote: Placing a moratorium on parking variances, so developers provide enough parking for their buildings.
their_part: Kept if he moves or votes for a pause on parking variances, or votes against each request to cut required parking. Not kept if he votes for one. We show the count, for example 4 of 5.
did_it_happen: How many parking variances council approves.

promise: Negotiate with Woodfibre LNG for a new recreation centre with a pool and ice rink.
quote: Negotiate with Woodfibre LNG for a new recreation centre with an ice rink and pool
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to make a new recreation centre with a pool and ice rink part of talks with Woodfibre LNG. Not kept if he votes against asking for it.
did_it_happen: Whether a new agreement with Woodfibre LNG includes money for a recreation centre.

promise: Hold property taxes flat in 2027, with no increase.
quote: Freeze property taxes for 2027
their_part: Kept if he moves or votes for a 0% increase in the 2027 budget, and votes against a 2027 budget that raises the District's property tax. Not kept if he votes for a 2027 budget with an increase.
did_it_happen: The 2027 property tax increase council adopts, as the District reports it. If he votes no and loses, his promise is still kept.

promise: Pause new bike lane and sidewalk upgrades until residents have been properly consulted.
quote: Placing a moratorium on active transportation upgrades until more effective community engagement has taken place.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to pause new bike lane and sidewalk projects until residents are consulted. Not kept if he votes to start a new one before that.
did_it_happen: Whether council pauses them.

promise: Work with BC Transit and the province for an express highway bus every 15 minutes.
quote: Partnering with BC Transit and the provincial government to establish an express bus down the highway every 15 minutes, making transit a more practical option
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for a formal District request to BC Transit and the Province for express highway buses every 15 minutes. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether express buses run every 15 minutes.

promise: Rebuild the District's economic development department.
quote: Rebuild and strengthen the Economic Development Department.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to add staff or money for economic development in the budget. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether the budget adds them.

promise: Create a full Tourism Master Plan.
quote: Develop a comprehensive Tourism Master Plan (TMP) to strategically manage and grow Squamish's visitor economy.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to fund and adopt a Tourism Master Plan. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council adopts one this term.

promise: Keep the growth boundary where it is until the neighbourhoods already planned are built.
quote: In my opinion, as a community we should be honouring the current boundary until the existing neighbourhoods are built out.
their_part: Not kept if he votes to expand the growth boundary for housing while planned areas like Oceanfront are still mostly unbuilt. Kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether council expands the boundary.

promise: Speed up an updated Official Community Plan.
quote: Fast-track an updated Official Community Plan (OCP) — Squamish needs a clear VISION.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to start the Official Community Plan update early in the term on a short timeline. Not kept if he votes to delay it.
did_it_happen: When council starts and adopts the update.

promise: Run a wide search for a new Chief Administrative Officer.
quote: Conduct a broad search for a new Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), Council's only employee.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes for an open, wide search when council hires a Chief Administrative Officer. Not kept if he votes to hire without one.
did_it_happen: Whether council runs a wide search. Hiring is often decided in closed meetings, so his vote may not be public.

promise: Bring in real performance reviews for the District's top managers.
quote: Introduce meaningful performance reviews for senior management and District leadership.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to set up regular performance reviews for the Chief Administrative Officer. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether reviews happen each year. The Chief Administrative Officer reviews other senior staff.

promise: Work with the RCMP on a new downtown safety plan.
quote: Work alongside the RCMP to develop and implement a new downtown safety strategy.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to work with the RCMP on a new downtown safety plan, or to fund one. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether the District and the RCMP adopt and carry out a plan.

promise: Push for a new community centre, using provincial and federal money.
quote: Advocate for a new community centre that meets Squamish's growing needs.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to plan a new community centre or to apply for grants for it. Not kept if he votes against planning it.
did_it_happen: Whether the District plans it and wins grant money.

promise: Bring back a grant writer to win provincial and federal money.
quote: Re-establish a grant writer to work on funding from provincial and federal sources.
their_part: Kept if he moves, seconds or votes to fund a District grant writer position. Not kept if he votes against it.
did_it_happen: Whether the budget funds the position.
